title: Electronic Spices 110mm X 40mm 6v 70mah Rectangle Shape Polycrystalline Mini Epoxy Solar Panel Pack of 1pcs
description: The 110mm x 40mm 6V 70mAh Mini Epoxy Solar Panel is a compact and efficient solar energy solution for powering small electronics, learning projects, and DIY experiments. Built with polycrystalline silicon cells and protected by a durable epoxy resin coating, this panel delivers a stable 6V DC output at up to 70mAh under direct sunlight. Its slim, rectangular design makes it perfect for integration into Arduino kits, solar-powered models, LED lighting setups, battery charging units, and more. The panel is lightweight and easy to mount, with flat backing and optional solder tabs or wires for connection. Ideal for students, hobbyists, and engineers, this panel supports environmental education while offering reliable performance in indoor lighting or sunlight. It’s also well-suited for science fairs, robotics, off-grid applications, or as a component in low-power energy harvesting systems.
